findings.finding: Existing test_config_with_cli_overrides passes the custom provider table and selected ID through ConfigBuilder; fixed config/mod merges cfg.model_providers and resolves the selected key. ModelProviderInfo exposes base_url/wire_api/auth/websocket fields used by the candidate. Config assertions catch a discarded override.

MockServer is declared before home/config/harness and retained for the whole case. Reusable POST /v1/responses match returns the existing completed SSE template. Harness receives the same actual configured provider in both ThreadManager and subsequent cloned Config, including resume. No request-count condition is invented.

The entire original case from first parent start through final shutdown is byte-identical. Real child/grandchild UserMessage ItemCompleted observation, 5-second waits, persisted markers, deleted child rollout, resumed parent identity and both NotFound assertions remain.
The common waiter only adds needle/thread ID to its existing timeout message; event predicate and timeout are unchanged.

This removes a real external-provider dependency from this one fixture; it does not prove the previous timeout occurred inside startup prewarm. Full original parallel scope remains the acceptance gate.

dependencies: core_test_support and wiremock are existing direct dev dependencies; responses module was already used in this file. No production/Cargo/BUILD/lock changes.
